quarterly_data.quarter: Siemens press release: Siemens partners with NVIDIA to advance AI-driven, (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Industrial AI at the Erlangen electronics factory (release): Siemens unveiled new AI applications co-developed with NVIDIA and tested in live production - an AI-driven virtual production ramp-up that it says reduces engineering effort by up to 85 percent and cuts time-to-market by up to 40 percent, and agent-based production planning that can enable cost savings of up to 20 percent; further applications are planned in the coming months. More than 100 AI algorithms are in use at the plant (about 1,000 employees), and Siemens is investing EUR 500 million in the site's transformation through 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: EUR 500 million investment in the Erlangen site through 2030; more than 100 AI algorithms in use
